description: NaCrSi₂O₆ is Esseneite structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.82 Å. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Cr-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.05 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent CrO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 34-59°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.65 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Si atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two equivalent Cr, and one Si atom.
